title: Saroj Rani v. Sudarshan Kumar Chadha

content.caseIdentity: Saroj Rani v. Sudarshan Kumar Chadha, AIR 1984 SC 1562
content.facts: Constitutional challenge to s. 9 of the HMA on the ground that a decree of restitution of conjugal rights violates the right to privacy and personal liberty under Article 21.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether s. 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is constitutionally valid.
content.ratioDecidendi: Section 9 is constitutionally valid. The decree aims at restoration of marital companionship and does not compel sexual intercourse. The remedy is a means of encouraging reconciliation and is consistent with the scheme of the Act.
content.holding: Upheld the constitutional validity of s. 9 HMA (restitution of conjugal rights).
